description: This file defines a PHP class Opencart.Admin.Model.Tool.Backup that manages database backup operations, including retrieving tables, records, and total record counts in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: A model class responsible for database backup-related operations such as fetching tables, records, and total record counts.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves all table names from the current database that match the database prefix.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Fetches records from a specified table with optional pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of records in a specified table.
